pages.title: Morphogenesis
pages.text: $(thing)Morphogenesis$()$(br2)How a blob of identical cells paints itself into a body: reaction and diffusion. Unlocks Turing morphogens.

$(thing)Insight$(): 120$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Synthetic Biology, Complex Analysis, Reaction and Diffusion.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 Minimal Synthetic Cell.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): An activator molecule a spreads by diffusion, catalyses its own production (in proportion to a² and inhibited by a second molecule h, with saturation κ at high a), decays at rate μ, and is also produced at a small basal rate. Write the rate of change of the activator concentration.
